subject: reasoning
question: Eight boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and B8 are sitting in a row facing towards the north (not necessarily in the same order). B6 is fifth to the right of B1. B4 is fifth to the right of B5. B5 is to the immediate right of B1. B8 is third to the left of B4. B2 is third to the right of B7. B7 is an immediate neighbour of B1. Who is sitting on the immediate left of B1?
solution:
**Given**: Eight boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7 and B8 are sitting in a row facing towards the north.

Based on the given conditions, we get the following arrangements-

1. B6 is fifth to the right of B1. B4 is fifth to the right of B5. B5 is to the immediate right of B1. From these, we get-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ea71554b61479b358ab1e0a7a8e2ac1044004be37dcde84e041ec5cf36272a.png] 

2. B8 is third to the left of B4. B2 is third to the right of B7. B7 is an immediate neighbour of B1. From these, we get the final arrangement a follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c7d02786742f43c5fa190c892a936a4a4bc75b7b45fc7a3284ccfb9bd0aa476.png] 

Therefore, we see that B7 is sitting to the immediate left of B1.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 2**’.
